notes.title: Demo Patch 0.4.6
notes.notes:
Some updates on how the game logic calculates time to help ensure that times are consistent from attempt to attempt.

[b]Tower Fire Rates[/b]
[list]
[*] Previously: A stunned tower's internal fire rate cooldown would pause
[*] Now: While a tower is stunned, their internal fire rate cooldown would tick up, so that when the stun wears off, if there is a valid target nearby and if their fire rate cooldown is complete, they will fire immediately.
[/list]

[b]Timers[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the way timers are handled for the core systems that handles movement for projectiles and enemies, as well as key buffs (Slow, Skittish, Stun)
[*] Improved the way calculations are handled for the core systems that handle enemy movement and damage calculations
[/list]

[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] To combat first time user issues, the button for 'Let's Go' appears automatically if you already have save data, and the big button with your progress bar will also act as a 'Let's Go' button if clicked.
[*] Enemies with the Regeneration power will regenerate only up to their maxHP. While the logic for regeneration was already capping the heal to an enemy's maxHealth, this display change should help to prevent any confusion about enemies 'overhealing'.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Demo v0.4.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to bring you the latest updates and fixes for [b]Skibi's Castle TD 2[/b]. Huge shoutout to all our amazing players and testers for your invaluable feedback and support. Here’s what’s new:

[u][b]Fixes and Updates[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where replaying a recently completed level would not display the score screen.
[*] Reduced the difficulty of achieving gold grades in several levels in Chapters 4, 5, and 6.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 6, Map 5 where a few of the high ground tiles were not providing a range bonus.
[*] Fixed an issue where starting a level while dragging a tower would alter the tower's appearance.
[/list]


[u][b]Upcoming Changes[/b][/u]

We plan to monitor the health of the demo for a few more weeks, then shift focus on building out the next features. 

In next update, we will share more details soon on what we have in store for early access and report on how you all did on the levels!

We couldn’t have done this without your help. Your feedback continues to drive us to improve and refine the game. Keep the suggestions coming, and as always, let us know if you encounter any more issues.

Thank you for being an amazing community!

Happy defending,
The Khookey Dev Team

notes.title: UPDATE: Skibi's Castle TD 2 Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are thrilled to announce that the demo for [b]Skibi's Castle TD 2[/b] is now live on Steam! For those of you who may not be familiar, Skibi's Castle TD 2 is a colorful, sticker-themed tower defense game developed by missing_tooltip and skotey, the same team behind the original. Command Skibi's defenses and protect her castle from Rydik's invaders by summoning troops and purchasing new towers and upgrades.

[b]Key Demo Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Challenging Puzzles: Engage in open-ended puzzles that reward strategic thinking and experimentation.
[*] Strategic Depth: Replay stages to perfect your scores in time and cost to earn the game's most valuable currency, piggoldrats!
[*] Indie Craftsmanship: Handcrafted by a passionate indie family company, ensuring a personal touch and a pinch of sarcasm.
[*] Original Music: Get into the zen mode with original tunes by haishoe, featuring nostalgic themes to match the seasonal settings.
[*] Leaderboards: Compete with friends on the leaderboards.
[/list]

[b]Journey Before Destination[/b]
Our vision for Skibi's Castle TD 2 is to reimagine tower defense from the ground up, merging upfront auto-battler planning with puzzle-like levels. SK2 is the first step in the journey for us, just like the original (fun fact: the Blizzard version of the game was actually Skibi Castle TD 1 version 6). To that end, we plan to have the full release before the year is out so you have a cool new game to play, and we can enjoy our holidays ːlunar2019grinningpigː.

After the game is released, our next step in 2025 is to listen to your feedback and expand upon the core gameplay. This could mean borrowing from roguelike and idle game systems, improving on the traditional survival mode, or introducing something new like a bullet hell tower defense RTS mission hybrid.

[b]Your Feedback Matters![/b]
We would love to hear your feedback on the game! Check out the demo, then let us know what is working for you and what isn't. We're open to any ideas for new game content, including towers, enemies, and mechanics. Your input is invaluable as we continue to develop and improve SK2.

[b]Wishlist and Support[/b]
Please consider adding [b]Skibi's Castle TD 2[/b] to your wishlist to stay updated with our latest developments and future updates. There will inevitably be some bugs, so please let us know if you encounter any issues.

[b]What's Next?[/b]
This demo highlights the 'summer' biome. Our plan is to work on the Fall biome next, in time for Steam Next Fest, and to have the Winter biome ready for the full release. We are excited to share this journey with you and look forward to your feedback and suggestions.

Creating games has been my lifelong passion, and I believe that how we reach our goals and what we learn along the way is more important than the destination itself. I hope that playing SK2 is as enjoyable and fulfilling for you as it was for us to create it. Let us know what you think, chat!

Thank you for the support, 
The Khookey Dev team

notes.title: 0.3.28 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Bug Fix
- Undid a change from 0.3.27 where your game speed setting would save inbetween rounds, menu navigation, etc. For some reason this was causing major bugs.

[b]Patch 0.3.27
[/b]
[u]General
[/u]- Added a locked version of the shop to choose level screen
- Added Steam icon for wishlisting on main page and in-game menu
- Changed build type text to "TD Fest '24 Demo"
- Game version updated from 3.1 to 3.2. This soft-resets leaderboards (the data isn't lost, there are just new new leaderboards for 3.2)
- Build v0.3.X / Game v3.2 is for the tower defense fest demo build July 29th (Monday). I will still be updating build v0.3.27 to v0.3.X whatever for bug fixes, but Game version will remain at 3.2.
- Fixed Lane 1 and 2 spawning issues on Winter preview stage (was an oversight on my part)
- Fixed Boss spawning behavior on Winter preview stages
- Updated playerprogression, maxscores, scores file naming so game version specific data can be saved and loaded properly.

[u]Gameplay
[/u]- Added a bunch of new towers, but none have been hooked up just yet
- Force is applied to any enemy, regardless if they have armor or are heavy or not. This means that force based attacks that were once not very powerful (like Blaster Master) are now useful again. Might be really overpowered.
- Updated icon for speed (from Queen castle)
- Updated icon for eagle eyes & high ground
- When enemies leak, their distance traveled will reset to 0, so for the purposes of targeting 'furthest' enemy they will no longer be prioritized over anything that hasn't leaked.
- Enemy regeneration should properly halt when the game is paused or if the game is over (level failed)
- Fire does 3x tick damage to Enemy Ice Shields, up from 2x. This is a preemptive buff due to how powerful and prevalent Quickdraw will be with 1 cost instead of 2. The interactions here might not be as balanced as it could be though.
- Eagle Eyes (and any support tower with a ‘fake’ attack) will not scale up and ‘pop’ to attack. These types of towers will rotate when it spots an enemy though.

[u]Tower Balance
[/u][b]Quickdraw[/b]
- Cost reduced from 2 to 1. 
- Damage per attack reduced from 5 to 3
- Number of shots remains the same
- Overall damage burst reduced from 15 to 9, but cost was reduced by 50%

[b]Blaster Master
[/b]- Doubled the force of its attacks (displacement) 
- Increased base range from 6 to 10
- Increased base damage from 15 to 25
- Increased the size of its projectile (and matching collider) to be 200% larger. This is a temp measure to make it 'larger' without messing with rectangular shaped colliders
- Still costs 3

[b]Pyro[/b]
- Now deals Fire damage upon impact, instead of normal damage
